claims: As of March 2026, Netflix is led by Co-CEOs Ted Sarandos and Greg Peters.
Ted Sarandos and Greg Peters took over from founder Reed Hastings in January 2023.
Reed Hastings is the founder of Netflix.
Greg Peters oversees operations and product.
Reed Hastings serves as Executive Chairman.
Greg Peters was formerly COO and Chief Product Officer.
Greg Peters focuses on technology and global operations.
Ted Sarandos focuses on content and creative endeavors.
Ted Sarandos, Greg Peters, and Reed Hastings continue to lead Netflix's streaming, advertising, and gaming initiatives as of 2026
